    52→// ─── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    53→
    54→type PageName =
    55→  | "home"
    56→  | "download"
    57→  | "panel"
    58→  | "verif"
    59→  | "discord"
    60→  | "tutorial"
    61→  | "changelog"
    62→  | "vip";
    63→
    64→interface Particle {
    65→  x: number;
    66→  y: number;
    67→  size: number;
    68→  speedY: number;
    69→  speedX: number;
    70→  rotation: number;
    71→  rotSpeed: number;
    72→  swayAmp: number;
    73→  swaySpeed: number;
    74→  swayOffset: number;
    75→  alpha: number;
    76→  type: number;
    77→  color: string;
    78→}
    79→
    80→// ─── Particle Canvas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    81→
    82→function ParticleCanvas() {
    83→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
    84→  const particlesRef = useRef<Particle[]>([]);
    85→  const timeRef = useRef(0);
    86→  const animRef = useRef<number>(0);
    87→
    88→  useEffect(() => {
    89→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    90→    if (!canvas) return;
    91→    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    92→    if (!ctx) return;
    93→
    94→    let w = 0, h = 0;
    95→
    96→    function resize() {
    97→      if (!canvas) return;
    98→      w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    99→      h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   100→    }
   101→    resize();
   102→    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
   103→
   104→    const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
   105→    const count = isMobile ? 25 : 55;
   106→
   107→    function createParticle(init: boolean): Particle {
   108→      return {
   109→        x: Math.random() * w,
   110→        y: init ? Math.random() * h : -20,
   111→        size: Math.random() * 5 + 2,
   112→        speedY: Math.random() * 0.8 + 0.3,
   113→        speedX: Math.random() * 0.4 - 0.2,
   114→        rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
   115→        rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
   116→        swayAmp: Math.random() * 0.8 + 0.3,
   117→        swaySpeed: Math.random() * 0.015 + 0.005,
   118→        swayOffset: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
   119→        alpha: Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05,
   120→        type: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
   121→        color:
   122→          Math.random() < 0.5
   123→            ? "37,99,235"
   124→            : Math.random() < 0.8
   125→              ? "96,165,250"
   126→              : "34,211,238",
   127→      };
   128→    }
   129→
   130→    const leaves: Particle[] = [];
   131→    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) leaves.push(createParticle(true));
   132→    particlesRef.current = leaves;
   133→
   134→    function drawParticle(p: Particle, t: number) {
   135→      if (!ctx) return;
   136→      ctx.save();
   137→      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
   138→      ctx.rotate(p.rotation);
   139→      ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
   140→
   141→      if (p.type === 0) {
   142→        ctx.beginPath();
   143→        ctx.moveTo(0, -p.size);
   144→        ctx.bezierCurveTo(p.size * 0.8, -p.size * 0.5, p.size * 0.8, p.size * 0.5, 0, p.size);
   145→        ctx.bezierCurveTo(-p.size * 0.8, p.size * 0.5, -p.size * 0.8, -p.size * 0.5, 0, -p.size);
   146→        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.color},1)`;
   147→        ctx.fill();
   148→      } else if (p.type === 1) {
   149→        ctx.beginPath();
   150→        ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   151→        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${p.color},1)`;
   152→        ctx.fill();
   153→      } else {
   154→        const s = p.size * 0.6;
   155→        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${p.color},1)`;
   156→        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
   157→        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-s, 0); ctx.lineTo(s, 0); ctx.stroke();
   158→        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -s); ctx.lineTo(0, s); ctx.stroke();
   159→        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.6, -s * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(s * 0.6, s * 0.6); ctx.stroke();
   160→        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(s * 0.6, -s * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.6, s * 0.6); ctx.stroke();
   161→      }
   162→      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   163→      ctx.restore();
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    function loop() {
   167→      if (!ctx || !canvas) return;
   168→      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
   169→      timeRef.current++;
   170→      const t = timeRef.current;
   171→      for (const p of particlesRef.current) {
   172→        p.y += p.speedY;
   173→        p.x += p.speedX + Math.sin(t * p.swaySpeed + p.swayOffset) * p.swayAmp * 0.3;
   174→        p.rotation += p.rotSpeed;
   175→        if (p.y > h + 20) Object.assign(p, createParticle(false));
   176→        if (p.x < -20) p.x = w + 20;
   177→        if (p.x > w + 20) p.x = -20;
   178→        drawParticle(p, t);
   179→      }
   180→      animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
   181→    }
   182→    loop();
   183→
   184→    return () => {
   185→      window.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
   186→      cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current);
   187→    };
   188→  }, []);
   189→
   190→  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="fixed inset-0 z-[1] pointer-events-none" aria-hidden="true" />;
   191→}
   192→
   193→// ─── Toast ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   194→
   195→function Toast({ message, visible }: { message: string; visible: boolean }) {
   196→  return (
   197→    <div
   198→      className={`fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-[200] font-mono text-xs font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border pointer-events-none will-change-transform ${
   199→        visible
   200→          ? "translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-0 opacity-100"
   201→          : "translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-20 opacity-0"
   202→      }`}
   203→      style={{
   204→        background: "var(--ast-bg3)",
   205→        borderColor: "var(--ast-border2)",
   206→        color: "var(--ast-blue-l)",
   207→        boxShadow: "0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
   208→        transition: "transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   209→      }}
   210→    >
   211→      ⬇ {message}
   212→    </div>
   213→  );
   214→}
   215→
   216→// ─── Status Bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   217→
   218→function StatusBar({ dotColor, label, value, valueColor, valueGradient = false, live = false, bigDot = false, bump = false }: {
   219→  dotColor: string; label: string; value: string; valueColor: string; valueGradient?: boolean; live?: boolean; bigDot?: boolean; bump?: boolean;
   220→}) {
   221→  // WhatsApp-style: uniform gray bar, rounded pill shape, subtle dot (no glow)
   222→  const dotColors: Record<string, string> = {
   223→    green: "var(--ast-green)",
   224→    blue: "var(--ast-blue-l)",
   225→    cyan: "var(--ast-cyan)",
   226→    amber: "var(--ast-amber)",
   227→  };
   228→  const valColors: Record<string, string> = {
   229→    green: "var(--ast-green)",
   230→    blue: "var(--ast-blue-l)",
   231→    cyan: "var(--ast-cyan)",
   232→    white: "#ffffff",
   233→    amber: "var(--ast-amber)",
   234→  };
   235→  const isWhite = valueColor === "white";
   236→  const dotColorVal = dotColors[dotColor] || dotColors.green;
   237→  const dotSize = bigDot ? 10 : 8;
   238→
   239→  return (
   240→    <div
   241→      className="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 py-2.5 px-5 rounded-full border"
   242→      style={{
   243→        width: "76%",
   244→        maxWidth: "295px",
   245→        background: "rgba(30,36,50,0.65)",
   246→        borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
   247→        transition: "all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   248→        backdropFilter: "blur(8px)",
   249→      }}
   250→    >
   251→      <span
   252→        className={`rounded-full shrink-0 ${live ? "animate-[dot-ping_1.5s_ease-out_infinite]" : ""}`}
   253→        style={{
   254→          width: `${dotSize}px`,
   255→          height: `${dotSize}px`,
   256→          background: dotColorVal,
   257→          color: dotColorVal,
   258→        }}
   259→      />
   260→      <span className="text-[10.5px] font-semibold tracking-wider" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray)" }}>{label}</span>
   261→      <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray2)" }}>·</span>
   262→      <span
   263→        className={`font-mono tracking-wide ${isWhite ? "text-[14px] font-extrabold" : "text-[12px] font-bold"} ${bump ? "animate-[count-bump_0.5s_ease-out]" : ""}`}
   264→        style={{
   265→          color: valColors[valueColor],
   266→          textShadow: "none",
   267→        }}
   268→      >
   269→        {value}
   270→      </span>
   271→    </div>
   272→  );
   273→}
   274→
   275→// ─── App Bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   276→
   277→function AppBar({ icon, text, desc, highlight = false, newBadge = false, onClick }: {
   278→  icon: React.ReactNode; text: string; desc: string; highlight?: boolean; newBadge?: boolean; onClick: () => void;
   279→}) {
   280→  return (
   281→    <button
   282→      onClick={onClick}
   283→      type="button"
   284→      className={`flex items-center gap-3 py-4 px-6 rounded-2xl border w-full group ${
   285→        highlight ? "bg-[rgba(37,99,235,0.04)] border-[rgba(37,99,235,0.1)]" : ""
   286→      }`}
   287→      style={{
   288→        background: highlight ? undefined : "var(--ast-bar-bg)",
   289→        borderColor: highlight ? undefined : "var(--ast-border)",
   290→        transition: "all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   291→      }}
   292→    >
   293→      <span className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center w-[24px] [&_svg]:opacity-80 [&_svg]:text-white group-hover:scale-110" style={{ transition: "transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)" }}>
   294→        {icon}
   295→      </span>
   296→      <span className={`text-[13px] font-bold tracking-wide ${highlight ? "text-[var(--ast-blue-b)]" : ""}`}
   297→        style={highlight ? undefined : { color: "var(--ast-gray)" }}>
   298→        {text}
   299→        {newBadge && (
   300→          <span className="font-mono text-[7px] font-bold bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1d4ed8] to-[#2563eb] text-white px-1.5 py-[1px] rounded-[3px] ml-1 tracking-wider shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(37,99,235,0.2)]">
   301→            NEW
   302→          </span>
   303→        )}
   304→      </span>
   305→      <span className="flex-1" />
   306→      <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray)" }}>{desc}</span>
   307→    </button>
   308→  );
   309→}
   310→
   311→// ─── Link Box ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   312→
   313→function LinkBox({ title, url, desc, icon, item = "total", onDownload, size }: {
   314→  title: string; url: string; desc: string; icon: React.ReactNode;
   315→  item?: string; onDownload?: (item: string) => void; size?: string;
   316→}) {
   317→  return (
   318→    <a
   319→      href={url}
   320→      target="_blank"
   321→      rel="noopener noreferrer"
   322→      onClick={() => onDownload?.(item)}
   323→      className="flex items-center gap-4 py-4 px-5 rounded-2xl border group cursor-pointer"
   324→      style={{
   325→        background: "var(--ast-bg2)",
   326→        borderColor: "var(--ast-border)",
   327→        transition: "all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   328→        textDecoration: "none",
   329→        marginBottom: "10px",
   330→      }}
   331→      onMouseEnter={(e) => {
   332→        e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = "rgba(37,99,235,0.15)";
   333→        e.currentTarget.style.background = "rgba(37,99,235,0.03)";
   334→        e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateX(3px)";
   335→      }}
   336→      onMouseLeave={(e) => {
   337→        e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = "var(--ast-border)";
   338→        e.currentTarget.style.background = "var(--ast-bg2)";
   339→        e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
   340→      }}
   341→    >
   342→      <div className="w-[40px] h-[40px] rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
   343→        style={{
   344→          background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f, #1d4ed8, #60a5fa)",
   345→          boxShadow: "0 2px 12px rgba(37,99,235,0.25)",
   346→          transition: "box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   347→        }}>
   348→        {icon}
   349→      </div>
   350→      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
   351→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
   352→          <div className="text-[13px] font-bold tracking-wide" style={{ color: "var(--ast-white)" }}>{title}</div>
   353→          {size && (
   354→            <span className="font-mono text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-[1px] rounded-[3px] tracking-wider"
   355→              style={{
   356→                background: "rgba(34,211,238,0.08)",
   357→                border: "1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.18)",
   358→                color: "var(--ast-cyan)",
   359→              }}>
   360→              {size}
   361→            </span>
   362→          )}
   363→        </div>
   364→        <div className="text-[11px] mt-[2px] truncate" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray)" }}>{desc}</div>
   365→      </div>
   366→      <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 opacity-40 group-hover:opacity-80" style={{ color: "var(--ast-blue-l)", transition: "opacity 0.3s" }} />
   367→    </a>
   368→  );
   369→}
   370→
   371→// ─── Download Button ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   372→
   373→function DownloadButton({ theme, icon, text, onClick, style }: {
   374→  theme: "blue" | "cyan" | "green" | "purple" | "amber" | "red" | "seller";
   375→  icon: React.ReactNode; text: string; onClick: () => void; style?: React.CSSProperties;
   376→}) {
   377→  const gradients: Record<string, React.CSSProperties> = {
   378→    blue: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#1d4ed8,#3b82f6)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(37,99,235,0.25)" },
   379→    cyan: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#0e7490,#22d3ee)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(34,211,238,0.2)" },
   380→    green: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#15803d,#22c55e)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(34,197,94,0.2)" },
   381→    purple: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#a855f7)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(168,85,247,0.2)" },
   382→    amber: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#92400e,#f59e0b)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(245,158,11,0.2)" },
   383→    red: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg,#991b1b,#ef4444)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(239,68,68,0.2)" },
   384→    seller: { background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f, #1d4ed8, #60a5fa)", boxShadow: "0 6px 24px rgba(37,99,235,0.3)" },
   385→  };
   386→
   387→  return (
   388→    <button
   389→      onClick={onClick}
   390→      className="relative flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 w-full py-[18px] rounded-2xl border-none text-white cursor-pointer font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans'] text-[15px] font-extrabold overflow-hidden will-change-transform group"
   391→      style={{
   392→        ...gradients[theme],
   393→        ...style,
   394→        transition: "transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   395→        marginBottom: "12px",
   396→      }}
   397→      onMouseEnter={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(-3px)"; }}
   398→      onMouseLeave={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(0)"; }}
   399→      onMouseDown={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(0) scale(0.98)"; }}
   400→      onMouseUp={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.transform = "translateY(-3px)"; }}
   401→    >
   402→      <span className="absolute top-0 left-[-100%] w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/15 to-transparent" style={{ transition: "left 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)" }} />
   403→      {icon}
   404→      {text}
   405→    </button>
   406→  );
   407→}
   408→
   409→// ─── Feature Item ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   410→
   411→function FeatureItem({ num, theme, title, desc, dark }: {
   412→  num: string; theme: string; title: string; desc: string; dark?: boolean;
   413→}) {
   414→  const colorMap: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string }> = {
   415→    blue: { bg: "rgba(37,99,235,0.08)", color: "var(--ast-blue-l)" },
   416→    cyan: { bg: "rgba(34,211,238,0.08)", color: "var(--ast-cyan)" },
   417→    green: { bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.08)", color: "var(--ast-green)" },
   418→    purple: { bg: "rgba(168,85,247,0.08)", color: "var(--ast-purple)" },
   419→    amber: { bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.08)", color: "var(--ast-amber)" },
   420→    red: { bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)", color: "var(--ast-red)" },
   421→  };
   422→  const c = colorMap[theme] || colorMap.blue;
   423→
   424→  return (
   425→    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 py-4 border-b border-[var(--ast-border)] last:border-b-0" style={{ transition: "padding-left 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)" }}
   426→      onMouseEnter={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.paddingLeft = "4px"; }}
   427→      onMouseLeave={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.paddingLeft = "0"; }}
   428→    >
   429→      <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[11px] font-bold shrink-0" style={{ background: dark ? "rgba(107,123,168,0.06)" : c.bg, color: dark ? "#4a5568" : c.color, fontSize: num.length > 2 ? "13px" : undefined }}>
   430→        {num}
   431→      </div>
   432→      <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: dark ? "#6b7280" : "var(--ast-gray)" }}>
   433→        <strong className={dark ? "" : "text-white"} style={dark ? { color: "#6b7280", fontWeight: 600 } : { fontWeight: 600 }}>{title}</strong>{dark ? " — " : " — "}{desc}
   434→      </div>
   435→    </div>
   436→  );
   437→}
   438→
   439→// ─── Reveal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   440→
   441→function Reveal({ children, delay = 0 }: { children: React.ReactNode; delay?: number }) {
   442→  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
   443→  useEffect(() => {
   444→    const timer = setTimeout(() => setVisible(true), delay + 80);
   445→    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
   446→  }, [delay]);
   447→
   448→  return (
   449→    <div
   450→      className="will-change-transform"
   451→      style={{
   452→        opacity: visible ? 1 : 0,
   453→        transform: visible ? "translateY(0)" : "translateY(20px)",
   454→        transition: `opacity 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) ${delay}ms, transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) ${delay}ms`,
   455→      }}
   456→    >
   457→      {children}
   458→    </div>
   459→  );
   460→}
   461→
   462→// ─── Swipeable Feature Carousel (Box + Sound on swipe, Smooth) ──────────────
   463→
   464→function FeatureCarousel({ items, theme = "blue" }: {
   465→  items: { num: string; title: string; desc: string; features?: string[] }[];
   466→  theme?: string;
   467→}) {
   468→  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
   469→  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
   470→  const lastIdxRef = useRef<number>(0);
   471→  const rafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
   472→  const [activeIdx, setActiveIdx] = useState<number>(0);
   473→
   474→  // Color theme — kept identical between blue/amber so layout is consistent
   475→  const themeStyles: Record<string, {
   476→    boxGradient: string;
   477→    boxShadow: string;
   478→    chipGradient: string;
   479→    chipShadow: string;
   480→    accent: string;
   481→    indicatorActive: string;
   482→    labelColor: string;
   483→  }> = {
   484→    blue: {
   485→      boxGradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(37,99,235,0.10) 0%, rgba(37,99,235,0.02) 60%, var(--ast-bg2) 100%)",
   486→      boxShadow: "0 4px 24px rgba(37,99,235,0.12), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
   487→      chipGradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f, #1d4ed8, #60a5fa)",
   488→      chipShadow: "0 2px 10px rgba(37,99,235,0.30)",
   489→      accent: "var(--ast-blue-l)",
   490→      indicatorActive: "var(--ast-blue-l)",
   491→      labelColor: "var(--ast-blue-l)",
   492→    },
   493→    amber: {
   494→      boxGradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.12) 0%, rgba(245,158,11,0.02) 60%, var(--ast-bg2) 100%)",
   495→      boxShadow: "0 4px 24px rgba(245,158,11,0.14), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
   496→      chipGradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #92400e, #f59e0b, #fbbf24)",
   497→      chipShadow: "0 2px 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.32)",
   498→      accent: "var(--ast-amber)",
   499→      indicatorActive: "var(--ast-amber)",
   500→      labelColor: "var(--ast-amber)",
   501→    },
   502→  };
   503→  const ts = themeStyles[theme] || themeStyles.blue;
   504→
   505→  // Play swipe sound — single Audio instance, reset to 0 each time
   506→  const playSwipeSound = useCallback(() => {
   507→    try {
   508→      if (!audioRef.current) {
   509→        const a = new Audio("/flip.mp3");
   510→        a.volume = 0.3;
   511→        a.preload = "auto";
   512→        audioRef.current = a;
   513→      }
   514→      audioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
   515→      audioRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
   516→    } catch {}
   517→  }, []);
   518→
   519→  // Compute current visible index based on scroll position
   520→  const computeIdx = useCallback(() => {
   521→    const el = scrollRef.current;
   522→    if (!el) return 0;
   523→    // Each child has flex-basis ~82% width + gap 12px
   524→    const firstChild = el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null;
   525→    if (!firstChild) return 0;
   526→    const step = firstChild.offsetWidth + 12; // 12 = gap
   527→    const idx = Math.round(el.scrollLeft / step);
   528→    return Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, idx));
   529→  }, [items.length]);
   530→
   531→  // Throttled scroll handler using rAF for smoothness
   532→  const handleScroll = useCallback(() => {
   533→    if (rafRef.current != null) return;
   534→    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
   535→      rafRef.current = null;
   536→      const idx = computeIdx();
   537→      if (idx !== lastIdxRef.current) {
   538→        lastIdxRef.current = idx;
   539→        setActiveIdx(idx);
   540→        playSwipeSound();
   541→      }
   542→    });
   543→  }, [computeIdx, playSwipeSound]);
   544→
   545→  // Smooth scroll to a specific box index
   546→  const scrollToIdx = useCallback((idx: number) => {
   547→    const el = scrollRef.current;
   548→    if (!el) return;
   549→    const firstChild = el.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null;
   550→    if (!firstChild) return;
   551→    const step = firstChild.offsetWidth + 12;
   552→    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, idx));
   553→    const targetLeft = target * step;
   554→
   555→    // Use native smooth scroll, with a small fallback for browsers that don't honor it
   556→    el.scrollTo({ left: targetLeft, behavior: "smooth" });
   557→    if (lastIdxRef.current !== target) {
   558→      lastIdxRef.current = target;
   559→      setActiveIdx(target);
   560→      playSwipeSound();
   561→    }
   562→  }, [items.length, playSwipeSound]);
   563→
   564→  const scrollByBox = useCallback((dir: 1 | -1) => {
   565→    scrollToIdx(lastIdxRef.current + dir);
   566→  }, [scrollToIdx]);
   567→
   568→  // Cleanup rAF on unmount
   569→  useEffect(() => {
   570→    return () => {
   571→      if (rafRef.current != null) {
   572→        cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
   573→      }
   574→    };
   575→  }, []);
   576→
   577→  return (
   578→    <div className="relative">
   579→      {/* Arrows (desktop) */}
   580→      <button
   581→        type="button"
   582→        aria-label="Previous"
   583→        onClick={() => scrollByBox(-1)}
   584→        className="hidden sm:flex absolute -left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 w-9 h-9 rounded-full items-center justify-center cursor-pointer border"
   585→        style={{
   586→          background: "var(--ast-bg2)",
   587→          borderColor: "var(--ast-border)",
   588→          color: "var(--ast-gray)",
   589→        }}
   590→      >
   591→        <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
   592→      </button>
   593→      <button
   594→        type="button"
   595→        aria-label="Next"
   596→        onClick={() => scrollByBox(1)}
   597→        className="hidden sm:flex absolute -right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 w-9 h-9 rounded-full items-center justify-center cursor-pointer border"
   598→        style={{
   599→          background: "var(--ast-bg2)",
   600→          borderColor: "var(--ast-border)",
   601→          color: "var(--ast-gray)",
   602→        }}
   603→      >
   604→        <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
   605→          <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12" />
   606→          <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19" />
   607→        </svg>
   608→      </button>
   609→
   610→      {/* Horizontal scroll container — smooth + momentum */}
   611→      <div
   612→        ref={scrollRef}
   613→        onScroll={handleScroll}
   614→        className="feature-carousel-scroll flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-3 -mx-1 px-1"
   615→        style={{
   616→          scrollSnapType: "x mandatory",
   617→          scrollBehavior: "smooth",
   618→          willChange: "scroll-position",
   619→          transform: "translateZ(0)",
   620→          scrollPaddingLeft: "4px",
   621→          scrollPaddingRight: "4px",
   622→        } as React.CSSProperties}
   623→      >
   624→        {items.map((it, i) => (
   625→          <div
   626→            key={i}
   627→            className="shrink-0 snap-start"
   628→            style={{
   629→              flexBasis: it.features ? "90%" : "82%",
   630→              maxWidth: it.features ? "90%" : "82%",
   631→              // GPU acceleration per-box
   632→              transform: "translateZ(0)",
   633→              willChange: "transform",
   634→            }}
   635→          >
   636→            {/* Feature box — gradient bg, depth shadow, prominent icon chip */}
   637→            <div
   638→              className="rounded-2xl p-5 border relative overflow-hidden"
   639→              style={{
   640→                background: ts.boxGradient,
   641→                borderColor: "var(--ast-border)",
   642→                boxShadow: ts.boxShadow,
   643→                transition: "border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)",
   644→                minHeight: it.features ? "200px" : "auto",
   645→              }}
   646→            >
   647→              {/* Top row: gradient chip + feature label */}
   648→              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-3">
   649→                <div
   650→                  className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[14px] font-bold shrink-0"
   651→                  style={{
   652→                    background: ts.chipGradient,
   653→                    boxShadow: ts.chipShadow,
   654→                    color: "#fff",
   655→                  }}
   656→                >
   657→                  {it.num}
   658→                </div>
   659→                <div className="flex flex-col">
   660→                  <div className="font-mono text-[8px] tracking-[0.18em] uppercase font-bold" style={{ color: ts.labelColor }}>
   661→                    {it.features ? "KATEGORI" : "FEATURE"} {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
   662→                  </div>
   663→                  <div className="text-[15px] font-extrabold leading-tight" style={{ color: "var(--ast-white)" }}>
   664→                    {it.title}
   665→                  </div>
   666→                </div>
   667→              </div>
   668→
   669→              {/* Grouped feature list or single desc */}
   670→              {it.features ? (
   671→                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1">
   672→                  {it.features.map((feat, fi) => (
   673→                    <div key={fi} className="flex items-start gap-2">
   674→                      <span className="text-[11px] mt-[2px] shrink-0" style={{ color: ts.accent }}>✅</span>
   675→                      <span className="text-[12px] leading-snug" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray)" }}>{feat}</span>
   676→                    </div>
   677→                  ))}
   678→                </div>
   679→              ) : (
   680→                <>
   681→                  {/* Title (for non-grouped items) — shown below chip row only when no features list */}
   682→                  <div className="text-[14.5px] font-extrabold mb-1.5 leading-tight" style={{ color: "var(--ast-white)" }}>
   683→                    {it.title}
   684→                  </div>
   685→                  {/* Desc */}
   686→                  <div className="text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray)" }}>
   687→                    {it.desc}
   688→                  </div>
   689→                </>
   690→              )}
   691→
   692→              {/* Top accent line */}
   693→              <div
   694→                className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] opacity-80 pointer-events-none"
   695→                style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, ${ts.accent}, transparent)` }}
   696→              />
   697→              {/* Decorative corner accent (subtle) */}
   698→              <div
   699→                className="absolute -bottom-8 -right-8 w-24 h-24 rounded-full opacity-25 pointer-events-none"
   700→                style={{ background: `radial-gradient(circle, ${ts.accent}, transparent 70%)` }}
   701→              />
   702→            </div>
   703→          </div>
   704→        ))}
   705→      </div>
   706→
   707→      {/* Page indicator dots + hint */}
   708→      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 mt-2.5">
   709→        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
   710→          {items.map((_, i) => (
   711→            <button
   712→              key={i}
   713→              type="button"
   714→              aria-label={`Go to feature ${i + 1}`}
   715→              onClick={() => scrollToIdx(i)}
   716→              className="rounded-full transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer"
   717→              style={{
   718→                width: i === activeIdx ? 16 : 5,
   719→                height: 5,
   720→                background: i === activeIdx ? ts.indicatorActive : "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
   721→                border: "none",
   722→                padding: 0,
   723→              }}
   724→            />
   725→          ))}
   726→        </div>
   727→        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
   728→          <svg className="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray2)" }}>
   729→            <polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6" />
   730→          </svg>
   731→          <span className="font-mono text-[9px] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase font-bold" style={{ color: "var(--ast-gray2)" }}>
   732→            Geser untuk lihat semua
   733→          </span>
   734→        </div>
   735→      </div>
   736→    </div>
   737→  );
   738→}
   739→
   740→// ─── Page Wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   741→
   742→function PageWrapper({ pageName, currentPage, children }: {
   743→  pageName: PageName; currentPage: PageName; children: React.ReactNode;
   744→}) {
   745→  const active = pageName === currentPage;
   746→
   747→  if (!active) return null;
   748→
   749→  return (
   750→    <div
   751→      className="max-w-[480px] mx-auto px-4 pb-24"
   752→      style={{
   753→        paddingTop: "80px",
   754→        animation: "pageSlideIn 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) forwards",
   755→      }}
   756→    >
   757→      {children}
   758→    </div>
   759→  );
   760→}
   761→
   762→// ─── Main App ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   763→
   764→export default function AstuteApp() {
   765→  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<PageName>("home");
   766→  const [panelOpen, setPanelOpen] = useState(false);
   767→  const [toastMsg, setToastMsg] = useState("");
   768→  const [toastVisible, setToastVisible] = useState(false);
   769→  const [downloadCount, setDownloadCount] = useState(1200);
   770→  const [countBump, setCountBump] = useState(false);
   771→  const [clock, setClock] = useState("00:00:00");
   772→  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
   773→  const [musicPlaying, setMusicPlaying] = useState(false);
   774→  const musicAutoStartedRef = useRef(false);
   775→  const panelSwipeRef = useRef<{ startX: number; currentX: number; swiping: boolean }>({ startX: 0, currentX: 0, swiping: false });
   776→  const toastTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   777→  const musicAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
   778→
   779→  // ─── Click Sound (MP3 file) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   780→  const clickAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
   781→  const playClickSound = useCallback(() => {
   782→    try {
   783→      if (!clickAudioRef.current) {
   784→        clickAudioRef.current = new Audio("/click.mp3");
   785→        clickAudioRef.current.volume = 0.4;
   786→      }
   787→      clickAudioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
   788→      clickAudioRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
   789→    } catch {}
   790→  }, []);
   791→
   792→  // ─── Background Music (MP3) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
   793→  const startMusic = useCallback(() => {
   794→    try {
   795→      if (!musicAudioRef.current) {
   796→        const audio = new Audio("/music.mp3");
   797→        audio.volume = 0.35;
   798→        audio.loop = true;
   799→        audio.preload = "auto";
   800→        musicAudioRef.current = audio;
   801→      }
   802→      const audio = musicAudioRef.current;
   803→      audio.play().then(() => {
   804→        setMusicPlaying(true);
   805→      }).catch(() => {
   806→        setMusicPlaying(false);
   807→      });
   808→    } catch {
   809→      setMusicPlaying(false);
   810→    }
   811→  }, []);
   812→
   813→  const stopMusic = useCallback(() => {
   814→    try {
   815→      if (musicAudioRef.current) {
   816→        musicAudioRef.current.pause();
   817→      }
   818→      setMusicPlaying(false);
   819→    } catch {}
   820→  }, []);
   821→
   822→  const toggleMusic = useCallback(() => {
   823→    if (musicPlaying) {
   824→      stopMusic();
   825→    } else {
   826→      startMusic();
   827→    }
   828→  }, [musicPlaying, startMusic, stopMusic]);
   829→
   830→  // Auto-start background music on first user interaction
   831→  useEffect(() => {
   832→    function onFirstInteraction() {
   833→      if (musicAutoStartedRef.current) return;
   834→      musicAutoStartedRef.current = true;
   835→      startMusic();
   836→      ["click", "touchstart", "keydown"].forEach(evt =>
   837→        document.removeEventListener(evt, onFirstInteraction)
   838→      );
   839→    }
   840→    ["click", "touchstart", "keydown"].forEach(evt =>
   841→      document.addEventListener(evt, onFirstInteraction, { once: false })
   842→    );
   843→    return () => {
   844→      ["click", "touchstart", "keydown"].forEach(evt =>
   845→        document.removeEventListener(evt, onFirstInteraction)
   846→      );
   847→    };
   848→  }, [startMusic]);
   849→
   850→  // Scroll detection for glass effect
   851→  useEffect(() => {
   852→    function onScroll() {
   853→      setScrolled(window.scrollY > 10);
   854→    }
   855→    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
   856→    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
   857→  }, []);
   858→
   859→  // Clock
   860→  useEffect(() => {
   861→    function updateClock() {
   862→      const n = new Date();
   863→      setClock(`${String(n.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(n.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0")}`);
   864→    }
   865→    updateClock();
   866→    const iv = setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
   867→    return () => clearInterval(iv);
   868→  }, []);
   869→
   870→  // ─── Real-time download counter (Firebase + SSE fallback) ──────────────
   871→  // Tries Firebase Realtime Database first; if unavailable, falls back to
   872→  // our own /api/download?stream=1 SSE endpoint. Either way, count updates
   873→  // live whenever anyone (this user or anyone else) clicks a download link.
   874→  const sseRef = useRef<EventSource | null>(null);
   875→  const fbUnsubRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
   876→
   877→  useEffect(() => {
   878→    let mounted = true;
   879→
   880→    async function initFirebase() {
   881→      try {
   882→        const mod = await import("@/lib/firebase");
   883→        const { db, firebaseEnabled } = mod;
   884→        if (!mounted || !db || !firebaseEnabled) return false;
   885→        const { ref, onValue } = await import("firebase/database");
   886→        const countRef = ref(db, "downloads/total");
   887→        fbUnsubRef.current = onValue(countRef, (snap) => {
   888→          if (!mounted) return;
   889→          const val = typeof snap.val() === "number" ? snap.val() : 1200;
   890→          setDownloadCount((prev) => {
   891→            if (val > prev) setCountBump(true);
   892→            return val;
   893→          });
   894→        });
   895→        return true;
   896→      } catch {
   897→        return false;
   898→      }
   899→    }
   900→
   901→    function initSSE() {
   902→      if (!mounted) return;
   903→      // Don't create duplicate polling loops
   904→      if (sseRef.current) return;
   905→      // Use polling instead of SSE because the preview proxy buffers
   906→      // streaming responses. Polling works through any HTTP proxy.
   907→      let stopped = false;
   908→      // @ts-ignore - we store the stop function in sseRef
   909→      sseRef.current = { close: () => { stopped = true; } } as any;
   910→
   911→      async function poll() {
   912→        // Initial fetch immediately
   913→        try {
   914→          const r = await fetch("/api/download", { cache: "no-store" });
   915→          if (r.ok) {
   916→            const j = await r.json();
   917→            if (j && typeof j.count === "number") {
   918→              setDownloadCount((prev) => {
   919→                if (j.count > prev) setCountBump(true);
   920→                return j.count;
   921→              });
   922→            }
   923→          }
   924→        } catch {}
   925→
   926→        // Then poll every 3 seconds
   927→        while (!stopped && mounted) {
   928→          await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 3000));
   929→          if (stopped || !mounted) break;
   930→          try {
   931→            const r = await fetch("/api/download", { cache: "no-store" });
   932→            if (!r.ok) continue;
   933→            const j = await r.json();
   934→            if (j && typeof j.count === "number") {
   935→              setDownloadCount((prev) => {
   936→                if (j.count !== prev) {
   937→                  if (j.count > prev) setCountBump(true);
   938→                  return j.count;
   939→                }
   940→                return prev;
   941→              });
   942→            }
   943→          } catch {}
   944→        }
   945→      }
   946→      poll();
   947→    }
   948→
   949→    (async () => {
   950→      const ok = await initFirebase();
   951→      if (!ok && mounted) initSSE();
   952→    })();
   953→
   954→    return () => {
   955→      mounted = false;
   956→      if (fbUnsubRef.current) {
   957→        try { fbUnsubRef.current(); } catch {}
   958→        fbUnsubRef.current = null;
   959→      }
   960→      if (sseRef.current) {
   961→        try { sseRef.current.close(); } catch {}
   962→        sseRef.current = null;
   963→      }
   964→    };
   965→  }, []);
   966→
   967→  // Clear bump flag right after it's set so the next increment can retrigger it
   968→  useEffect(() => {
   969→    if (!countBump) return;
   970→    const t = setTimeout(() => setCountBump(false), 600);
   971→    return () => clearTimeout(t);
   972→  }, [countBump]);
   973→
   974→  // ─── Organic growth — simulate other users clicking so the counter feels alive
   975→  // Schedules a +1 at a random interval between 12s and 28s, only when the page
   976→  // is visible. Each fire re-schedules a new random timeout.
   977→  const organicTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
   978→  useEffect(() => {
   979→    function scheduleNext() {
   980→      const delay = 12000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 16000); // 12s – 28s
   981→      organicTimerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   982→        // Only fire when the tab is visible (don't burn backend while hidden)
   983→        if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
   984→          try {
   985→            await fetch("/api/download", {
   986→              method: "POST",
   987→              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   988→              body: JSON.stringify({ item: "total" }),
   989→            });
   990→          } catch {}
   991→        }
   992→        scheduleNext();
   993→      }, delay);
   994→    }
   995→    scheduleNext();
   996→    return () => {
   997→      if (organicTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(organicTimerRef.current);
   998→    };
   999→  }, []);
  1000→
  1001→  // ─── Increment counter when a download link is clicked ─────────────────
  1002→  const incrementDownload = useCallback(async (item: string = "total") => {
  1003→    // Optimistic local bump for instant feedback
  1004→    setDownloadCount((c) => c + 1);
  1005→    setCountBump(true);
  1006→
  1007→    // Try Firebase first
  1008→    try {
  1009→      const mod = await import("@/lib/firebase");
  1010→      const { db, firebaseEnabled } = mod;
  1011→      if (db && firebaseEnabled) {
  1012→        const { ref, runTransaction } = await import("firebase/database");
  1013→        await runTransaction(ref(db, "downloads/total"), (cur) => (cur || 0) + 1);
  1014→        if (item !== "total") {
  1015→          await runTransaction(ref(db, `downloads/${item}`), (cur) => (cur || 0) + 1);
  1016→        }
  1017→        return;
  1018→      }
  1019→    } catch {}
  1020→
  1021→    // Fallback: POST /api/download (server broadcasts via SSE to all clients)
  1022→    try {
  1023→      await fetch("/api/download", {
  1024→        method: "POST",
  1025→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  1026→        body: JSON.stringify({ item }),
  1027→      });
  1028→    } catch {}
  1029→  }, []);
  1030→
  1031→  // Page navigation - smooth
  1032→  const goPage = useCallback((name: PageName) => {
  1033→    playClickSound();
  1034→    setCurrentPage(name);
  1035→    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  1036→  }, [playClickSound]);
  1037→
  1038→  // Toast
  1039→  const showToast = useCallback((msg: string) => {
  1040→    setToastMsg(msg);
  1041→    setToastVisible(true);
  1042→    if (toastTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimerRef.current);
  1043→    toastTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setToastVisible(false), 2400);
  1044→  }, []);
  1045→
  1046→  const handleDownload = useCallback((name: string) => {
  1047→    showToast(`Preparing: ${name}...`);
  1048→    incrementDownload(name.toLowerCase().includes("max") ? "ffmax"
  1049→      : name.toLowerCase().includes("biasa") ? "ffbiasa"
  1050→      : name.toLowerCase().includes("json") ? "json"
  1051→      : "total");
  1052→  }, [showToast, incrementDownload]);
  1053→
  1054→  const togglePanel = useCallback(() => {
  1055→    playClickSound();
  1056→    setPanelOpen((p) => !p);
  1057→  }, [playClickSound]);
  1058→
  1059→  // Clear inline swipe transform when panel re-opens
  1060→  useEffect(() => {
  1061→    if (panelOpen) {
  1062→      const nav = document.querySelector('[data-panel-nav]') as HTMLElement;
  1063→      if (nav) {
  1064→        nav.style.transform = "";
  1065→        nav.style.transition = "";
  1066→      }
  1067→    }
  1068→  }, [panelOpen]);
  1069→
  1070→  const formattedCount = downloadCount.toLocaleString("en-US");
  1071→
  1072→  const panelLinks: { name: PageName; icon: React.ReactNode; title: string; desc: string }[] = [
  1073→    { name: "download", icon: <Flame className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "ASTUTE OB 54", desc: "Download main APK" },
  1074→    { name: "panel", icon: <Settings className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "PANEL ASTUTE", desc: "Control panel & config" },
  1075→    { name: "verif", icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "VERIF MANUAL", desc: "Bypass verification" },
  1076→    { name: "discord", icon: <DiscordIcon className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "DISCORD SERVER", desc: "Community & support" },
  1077→    { name: "tutorial", icon: <PlayCircle className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "VIDEO TUTORIAL", desc: "Step by step guide" },
  1078→    { name: "changelog", icon: <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "FITUR VIP ACCESS", desc: "VIP features list" },
  1079→    { name: "vip", icon: <Crown className="w-6 h-6" />, title: "PEMBELIAN VIP", desc: "Beli VIP & chat admin" },
  1080→  ];
  1081→
  1082→  return (
  1083→    <div
  1084→      className="min-h-screen overflow-x-hidden antialiased relative"

  1326→        onTouchStart={(e) => {
  1327→          if (!panelOpen) return;
  1328→          panelSwipeRef.current = { startX: e.touches[0].clientX, currentX: e.touches[0].clientX, swiping: true };
  1329→        }}
  1330→        onTouchMove={(e) => {
  1331→          if (!panelSwipeRef.current.swiping) return;
  1332→          panelSwipeRef.current.currentX = e.touches[0].clientX;
  1333→          const diff = panelSwipeRef.current.currentX - panelSwipeRef.current.startX;
  1334→          if (diff > 0) {
  1335→            e.preventDefault();
  1336→            const nav = e.currentTarget;

  1338→            nav.style.transform = `translateX(${diff}px)`;
  1339→          }
  1340→        }}

  1342→          if (!panelSwipeRef.current.swiping) return;
  1343→          panelSwipeRef.current.swiping = false;

  1345→          const nav = document.querySelector('[data-panel-nav]') as HTMLElement;
  1346→          if (nav) nav.style.transition = "";

  1350→            if (nav) nav.style.transform = "";
